rating.reasoning_summary: This strand is pure **Thematic Noise** with zero narrative cohesion. The tweets span a decade (2015-2025) and share only the superficial keyword 'robot'—ranging from Roomba vacuums, to eigenrobot's brick-hauling stunts (unrelated to robotics), to AI ethics thought experiments, to actual robotics R&D. There is no boundary object, no shared conversation, and no evolution of ideas. Eigenrobot's brick saga (the only mini-arc) is about personal audacity and physical comedy, not robotics. The strand fails all criteria: participants don't interact, concepts don't build on each other, and there's no utility beyond individual tweets as standalone content.
